visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of tool cards (image, titled box, CTA) and, with the partner options, a directory of partner tiles with tag labels or logos

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: optional image or logo | optional tag paragraph + title + text + CTA link. Partner tiles: tag paragraph (e.g. Direct Integration), partner name or logo, integration link

reuseGuidance: Use for cards that send visitors to tools, apps or partners. Tags get a modifier class from their text so the design pass can colour each tag type.
decisions: The source partner directory is filterable; this block renders the authored tiles without a client-side filter.
